Team —

Attached is a compact package I pulled together for the EoQ scoring window: a one-page executive brief, the evidence compact (condensed screenshots + metric pulls), and an annotations workbook with line-by-line score rationale. I tried to keep this as terse as possible; the goal is one pass sign-off for exec QBR delivery.

High-level asks:
- Please review the proposed objective scores in column B of okr-score-annotations.xlsx and add one-line clarifications in column D if you disagree.
- Flag any critical evidence gaps by EOD today (29-Mar) so we can either pull the additional data or mark as NA with rationale.
- Laura: can you sanity-check the executive brief language for tone?
- Vivek: please confirm acceptance of the resilience downgrade (Objective 3) or propose alternate mitigations.

Quick snapshot (proposed):
- Objective 1 (Serving reliability): 85% -> Score: 75 (miss: two incident windows impacting SLA)
- Objective 2 (Cost per token): 12% reduction -> Score: 90 (on track)
- Objective 3 (Private deployment onboarding): 60% -> Score: 60 (miss; backlog + compliance delays)
- Objective 4 (Developer DX): 95% -> Score: 95 (exceeded)

Attachments: evidence-compact.pdf (1p), okr-score-annotations.xlsx (sheet per objective), exec-brief-onepager.docx

If we can get sign-off tomorrow morning, I will merge into the QBR deck and finalize the speaker notes.

Thanks —
Kimberly
